description: Estimate what a provider earns per month on Lium by listing GPUs of a model, as the rewards calculator does: rental income (95% of the renter price) and rented extra at the last 30 days' utilisation, plus idle pay at the validator's rate for every unrented hour; with what those GPUs actually earned and the middle-half range across providers. Use when someone asks what their GPUs could earn on Lium; for renting GPUs use search_gpus. An estimate, not a guarantee.

count.description: How many GPUs of that model (default 1)

gpu.description: GPU model, e.g. H100, B200, RTX 4090 (case and spacing ignored)

name: estimate_provider_earnings
title: Estimate Lium provider earnings
